explication: This is legacy macOS AlDente code: a menu-bar battery charge limiter, not the current proprietary product described in the README. The main workflow loads a saved charge target, presents it in the popover, periodically reads battery state, and toggles charging and sleep prevention; an optional classic-SMC-key path writes a limit directly. The privileged XPC helper performs SMC operations and manages power assertions. README-only Pro features are not evidenced as implemented here, so they are not mapped. Edges reflect excerpted calls or README statements; unsampled feature implementations are omitted.
